description: Returns normalized, source-linked business records for independent Orange County, CA car-rental providers. Use when: the user wants to find or compare independent local car-rental businesses in Orange County with constraints such as city, vehicle type, or monthly rentals. Do not use when: the user needs national chains or franchises, a category outside car rentals, guaranteed real-time prices or inventory, payment, or a completed reservation.

city.description: Optional Orange County city name, such as Irvine or Costa Mesa.

monthly_rentals.description: Optional boolean; true limits results to providers with a published monthly-rental capability.

vehicle_type.description: Optional vehicle type or class published by the provider, such as SUV, exotic, or minivan.

name: search
title: Search Orange County Car Rentals
